B_score_normalization.details: No denominator is derived from model-output maxima, minima, means or confidence scores. GT/predictions are loaded as float32; predictions are rounded to integer coordinates, with ties-to-even, then the first predicted row is replaced by first GT. Strict center locations use (w-1)/2+x and integer-inclusive IoU uses x+w-1. PR uses <= at thresholds0..50 and reports20; SR uses > at21 linspace thresholds0..1 and reports the arithmetic mean, not a trapezoidal integral. Every original frame remains in the per-sequence denominator, including initialization and invalid annotations. Sequences are equally weighted. Independent vector arithmetic and the isolated supplied scalar PR/SR source produce identical full per-sequence curves.
